director.text: Namaste Riya, main Asha, tumhari AI teacher. Aaj fractions ko cricket shares jaise samjhenge. Tumhe cricket mein batting pasand hai ya bowling?
Theek hai, Riya—cricket pasand hai. Socho ek paratha ko 4 equal shares mein baanta; tum ek share logi ya do?
Koi baat nahi, Riya. Ek share 4 mein se 1 hota hai—use one-fourth kehte hain. Agar 2 shares lo, kitne shares honge?
Riya, tumne “4” kaha—shayad tum total equal shares bata rahi ho. Kya tum 4 total shares kehna chahti ho?
Riya, 1/4 mein 4 equal shares hote hain. Ab isi pattern se try karo: 1/3 means 1 of ___ equal groups.
director.card: Khaali jagah bharo: 1/3 means 1 of ___ equal groups.

director.text: Achha, Riya. Blank mein kaunsa number aayega?
director.card: Khaali jagah bharo: 1/3 means 1 of ___ equal groups.

director.text: Riya, tumne 6 likha. Ab 1/3 ko teen equal parts mein socho: 1 part, total kitne parts? Try karo.
director.card: Khaali jagah bharo: 1/3 means 1 of ___ equal groups.

director.text: Jaise 1/5 matlab pizza ke 5 equal pieces mein se 1 piece. Ab 1/3 mein total equal groups kitne hain—try karo.
director.card: Khaali jagah bharo: 1/3 means 1 of ___ equal groups.

director.text: Chalo, ab equal shares ko ek naye tareeke se practice karte hain. Main tumhare answer ka wait karungi. Ek roti ke 4 barabar tukde kiye. Ek tukde ko kya kehte hain?
director.card: Ek roti ke 4 barabar tukde kiye. Ek tukde ko kya kehte hain?

director.text: Riya, tumne 8 kaha. Roti ke total kitne equal tukde hain—4 ya 8? Ab sahi number chuno.
director.card: Ek roti ke 4 barabar tukde kiye. Ek tukde ko kya kehte hain?

director.text: Theek hai, Riya—tum aaj ke liye rukna chahti ho. Screen par teen choices hain: continue, short break, ya aaj stop. Tum kya choose karogi?
